author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam takes a look inside the actual rhinonoveros robot prop from Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls! Used in perhaps the most memorable gag of the film, this life-size rhino sculpture is full of details we never noticed on screen, from an articulated hatch door to fully detailed interior driver's seat. 

Learn more about this props and see more details at: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/catalog/id/496
Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls rhino scene: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q8t8Ir9SeRE

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
